scripts.db:up: bun --env-file=.env.local exec 'docker compose --env-file /dev/null -p finance-tracker-fresh-local -f compose.yaml up -d --wait'
scripts.db:down: bun --env-file=.env.local exec 'docker compose --env-file /dev/null -p finance-tracker-fresh-local -f compose.yaml down'
scripts.db:logs: bun --env-file=.env.local exec 'docker compose --env-file /dev/null -p finance-tracker-fresh-local -f compose.yaml logs --follow db'
scripts.db:test:up: bun --env-file=.env.test exec 'docker compose --env-file /dev/null -p finance-tracker-fresh-test -f compose.test.yaml up -d --wait'
scripts.db:test:down: bun --env-file=.env.test exec 'docker compose --env-file /dev/null -p finance-tracker-fresh-test -f compose.test.yaml down'
scripts.db:test:logs: bun --env-file=.env.test exec 'docker compose --env-file /dev/null -p finance-tracker-fresh-test -f compose.test.yaml logs --follow db'
scripts.check: bun --no-env-file run typecheck && bun --no-env-file run lint && bun --no-env-file run test && bun --no-env-file run build
